capabilities: Insert a table-of-contents block via command or code block
Navigate from numbered TOC entries to headings and back
Add display-only heading numbers that return to the TOC
Collapse and expand TOC branches with configurable depth
Copy, edit, and export TOC blocks and section outlines
extras: Works only in Reading view on desktop Obsidian 1.13.7+; Live Preview and mobile are explicitly unsupported. No network requests or telemetry; MIT license. Korean-language interface supported.
problem: Obsidian has no in-note table of contents that links back from body headings to the TOC without altering heading text or existing links.
summary: Insertable table-of-contents block with two-way navigation, display-only heading numbering, collapsible branches, and per-block styling.
